svg.title: Lamport clocks between two nodes
svg.desc: Time proceeds downward on nodes A and B, whose logical clocks both start at zero. A sends message m1, increasing its clock from zero to one and attaching timestamp one. While m1 is in transit, B performs two internal events, increasing its clock to one and then two. B receives m1, sets its clock to max of two and one plus one, which is three, and then delivers m1 to the application. B sends m2, increasing its clock to four and attaching timestamp four. A receives m2, sets its clock to max of one and four plus one, which is five, and then delivers m2. The max rule is used once per receive event. These are logical clock values, not physical times.
svg.metadata: Original worked example illustrating the Lamport clock algorithm supplied by the user. Header typography and arrowhead geometry match the user's previous happens-before diagram. Mathematical text is outlined Computer Modern.
